factsSkipped.note: Checked belltownpizza.net (no About/menu page resolved) and local coverage; no independent review names a single signature pie. A 'Signature Pies' menu section (Meatasaurus, the Duncan, McQueen's) appears only on the delivery-ordering site slicelife.com, which isn't an accepted source.

ridgepizza.com is only a neighborhood-chooser landing page with no menu. The Stranger's 2012 'Happiest Hour' piece on Ridge Pizza covers the room and happy hour but names no dish. No accepted source for a signature pie.

veracipizza.com homepage names no signature pie and its menu subpage 404'd. Seattle Met, Fearless Critic and West Side Seattle coverage discuss the wood-fired style and crust generally but don't single out one pie; reviewer mentions of pepperoni/Margherita are customer comments, not a stated signature.

verasballard.com names no signature pie. DoorDash reviewer picks (Loaded Potato, Hot Coppa, Pepperoni) come from a delivery app, not an accepted source; the Seattle Pizza Substack review (seattlepizza.substack.com) returned 403 and couldn't be read.

lakecitysopranos.com returned 403 Forbidden on repeated attempts and a web.archive.org fetch could not be accessed. Only third-party delivery/directory listings (Slicelife, Birdeye, MapQuest, Sluurpy) cover opened year, price, style or signature, and none are accepted sources.

No official restaurant website found; its Toast ordering page (order.toasttab.com/online/da-vinci) returned 403. Menu prices and a 'House Special' pizza appear only on third-party listings (Slicelife, Menupages), not accepted sources for opened, priceIndex, styleGroup or signature.

No official restaurant website found; its Seattle Food Truck profile page returned 403. A 'wood-fired Yucatan pizza' mention and other details appear only on the aggregator Atly, not an accepted source.

No official restaurant website found. Mentions of butter chicken and Achari chicken pizzas as popular items appear only on delivery/directory aggregators (DoorDash, Slice, Atly, MapQuest); no news coverage or opening story was found.

deleobrotherspizza.com's own site shows only a locations page (Seattle, WA and South Lake Tahoe, CA) and a placeholder About page with no real content. A same-named pizzeria found in Edina, MN has a different address and appears to be an unrelated business, so it wasn't used.

castellopizzaandpasta.com/menu gave priceIndex and signature but has no About/history section, so opened year and styleGroup remain unfound. A MapQuest listing claims 'serving since 2011' but a directory listing isn't an accepted source.

The archive source confirms an opened year but says Varlamos is known for its calzones, not a specific pizza, so no signature pie could be reported. No accepted own-site menu or published review gives whole-pizza prices or a style description; only a Scribd-hosted menu scan and third-party listings exist, which aren't accepted sources.
